This implies that Biricodar may modulate the activity of 2,3-dichloro-1-propanol dehalogenase, potentially affecting ABCG1. The presence of a predicted interaction between Biricodar and ABCG1 further supports a possible regulatory pathway involving these entities. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic link where Kaempherol could influence the activity of the dehalogenase, which in turn is targeted by Biricodar, thereby affecting ABCG1. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on predicted interactions and their sequential targeting, which may require further experimental validation.
